name: Soul Cutter
text:
You conjure a blade of spiritual energy and cut at the soul of a foe. Make a melee spell attack against your target's AC. On a success, you deal spirit damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the range, damage, and other parameters.

1 An adjacent target takes 3d6 spirit damage.

2 An adjacent target takes 6d6 spirit damage, and on a hit, it becomes Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

3 The blade flies out from you and attacks a target within 30 feet, dealing 6d6 spirit damage. The spell deals half damage on a failure (but not a critical failure), as the blade's divine influence guides your attack. Unless you critically fail, the target becomes enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

---
Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 for the 1-action version, or by 2d6 for the 2- and 3-action versions.
